data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Gross strengthening of GBP 7.824m for the 2017 Year of Account as it developed from 'One year later' to 'Two years later' estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2019 reporting year, Syndicate 1206 experienced a net release of GBP 1.0m in prior year claims reserves. This favourable development was primarily driven by the Property, Aviation, and Marine classes, although these were partially offset by unfavourable developments in other classes. The overall underwriting performance improved compared to the prior year. The 2017 Year of Account, specifically, showed a gross strengthening of GBP 7.824m.
raw_causal_phrases: improvement of GBP 1.0m to claims reserves established at the prior year end
favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes
partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as a gross figure was not explicitly stated or derivable from a full claims development triangle. The claims development table on page 13 only provides data for a single underwriting year (2017), not a full triangle across multiple years.
